lessons.retire_when: Revalidate role routing whenever live owner assignments supersede the cited consolidation.
lessons.rule: Reconcile the live issue, role, run, owned paths and current head before work. Codex builds, Claude reviews, OpenClaw handles required local-Mac checks. A role label or different model does not establish independence.
lessons.counterexample: An old handover assigns Claude to build #10 while the current owner instruction assigns it to Codex.
lessons.check: Record the live assignment, exact commit, context disclosure and remaining gate; retain existing merge authority without inventing new permission.

lessons.rule: Record what ran on which build. Builder checks, reviewer reproduction, CI, visual inspection and human research are separate evidence classes.
lessons.counterexample: Green CI or an available screenshot is described as independent usability or actual screen-reader verification.
lessons.check: Name command/manual step, result, runtime, SHA, artifact identity and limitations; leave unrun acceptance open.

lessons.rule: Use a clean locked install and regenerate outputs through their source. Validate the real API/client boundary and prior compatibility baseline; do not hand-edit generated files or refresh the baseline to hide a break.
lessons.counterexample: A sibling constraint next to an unchanged $ref breaks a client while a shallow schema-name comparison passes.
lessons.check: Run applicable generated/compatibility/build/type/unit/fixture checks; demonstrate real-validator counterexamples for compatibility fixes and record substitutions.

lessons.rule: Effective-date and freshness rules must agree across summary, claims, actions, prerequisites and warnings. Never promote future-effective or historical evidence into today's recommended actions.
lessons.counterexample: A warning says evidence needs a current check while the summary still asserts that a program is open now.
lessons.check: Use a pinned as_of, test both sides of date boundaries and assert forbidden confident wording is absent.

lessons.rule: Frontend completion includes actual rendered inspection, ranked visual weaknesses, fixes and reinspection, with intended fonts, phone/desktop and themes as applicable.
lessons.counterexample: An automated screenshot exists but no one inspected focus return, wrapping or the changed state.
lessons.check: Record conditions and before/after artifacts; preserve keyboard focus and truthful evidence labels; actual zoom/AT claims need actual execution. Use LFS for raster evidence under current policy.

lessons.retire_when: Revalidate #10 scope after existing-surface delivery, an export implementation or a new approved vocabulary decision.
lessons.rule: Preserve approved evidence words and service statuses. #10 consolidates existing surfaces; export parity remains outstanding until an export exists and is verified.
lessons.counterexample: Unifying UI labels is used to close the issue's unimplemented export acceptance or silently rename an approved state.
lessons.check: Check live #10 scope, one-to-one schema-to-word coverage, generation drift and actual consumers; separately record deferred export coverage.

lessons.rule: Preserve server-only credentials, guarded fixture mode, loopback test controls and validate-before-mutate semantics. The Next BFF does not acquire backend business logic.
lessons.counterexample: A convenient browser query parameter changes the fixture fault or exposes the backend key.
lessons.check: Exercise startup/auth boundaries and invalid atomic updates; no new HTTP harness controls, paid calls, hosting or live providers in this pilot.

lessons.rule: Isolate fresh synthetic actors from acceptance criteria and expected answers. Keep source-release decisions, named human checks and model evaluations distinct; preserve their provenance.
lessons.counterexample: A primed agent report is entered as fresh user research or a reviewed source is treated as cleared for public release.
lessons.check: Label priming, task variant and observed coverage; transcribe only explicit owner/human records; keep research fixtures outside production retrieval and held-out evaluations.
